theorems.theorem_title: All finite Zipf moments are ratios of shifted harmonic sums
theorems.formal_statement:
namespace ZipfLaw

theorem zipfPMF_moment (N : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (k : ℝ) ^ p * zipfPMF N s k) =
      genHarmonic N (s - p) / genHarmonic N s := by sorry

end ZipfLaw
theorems.natural_language_statement: For every cutoff $N\in\mathbb N$, real exponent $s$, and integer moment order $p\ge0$, the finite Zipf law satisfies $\sum_{k=1}^{N} k^p f(k;s,N)=H_{N,s-p}/H_{N,s}$. The identity includes $N=0$ under Lean's convention for division by zero. The first and second moment formulas in the mission are its special cases.
theorems.source: Wikipedia, "Zipf's law", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipf%27s_law, section "Formal definition"; auxiliary lemma for the original ZipfLaw mission, derived from its displayed PMF and generalized harmonic sum.
